title: AI connections
description: Connect ChatGPT or Claude to your Spifex workspaces. You choose which workspaces and data each assistant can access, and you can revoke access at any time.

endpoint.copyError: Could not copy the endpoint. Please copy it manually.

how.title: Connect an assistant
how.description: In ChatGPT or Claude, open the connectors settings and add Spifex as a custom MCP connector using the URL below. You will be asked to sign in and approve the connection.
how.step1: Add the connector URL https://api.spifex.com/mcp in your AI assistant.
how.step2: Sign in to Spifex and approve the connection.
how.step3: Choose the workspaces and data the assistant can access in AI connections.

list.title: Connected assistants
list.description: Each assistant can only use the workspaces and data you enable for it.
list.duplicates: Multiple rows with the same name are separate registrations created by repeated connection attempts. Revoke each one you no longer use.

revoke.confirm: Revoke access for {{client}}? The assistant will lose access immediately and must be connected again to continue.

empty: No assistants are connected yet. Add Spifex in ChatGPT or Claude to get started.
